general.name: bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view
general.description: A spy satellite simulator in your browser, except the data is real. Live open source spatial intelligence on a photorealistic 3D globe.
general.description_zh: 在浏览器中运行的间谍卫星模拟器，但数据是真实的。基于逼真 3D 地球的实时开源空间情报。

general.name: alibaba/open-code-review
general.description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
general.description_zh: 安全、快速、高效，经阿里巴巴大规模实战检验。混合架构代码审查工具：确定性 pipeline + LLM Agent，精确到行级注释，内置多语言规则集（NPE、线程安全、XSS、SQL 注入），兼容 OpenAI 与 Anthropic。

general.name: affaan-m/ECC
general.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
general.description_zh: 智能体框架性能优化系统。为 Claude Code、Codex、Opencode、Cursor 等提供技能、直觉、记忆、安全性及研究优先的开发能力。

general.name: ayghri/i-have-adhd
general.description: A skill to stop your coding agent from burying the answer. ADHD-friendly output.
general.description_zh: 一款让编码 agent 不再把答案藏起来的技能，输出对 ADHD 友好。

general.name: tt-a1i/archify
general.description: Agent skill for beautiful, verifiable architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams—self-contained HTML with motion and crisp export.
general.description_zh: 用于生成精美、可验证的架构、工作流、时序、数据流和生命周期图表的 Agent skill——自包含 HTML，支持动效与清晰导出。

general.name: Tencent/WeKnora
general.description: Open-source LLM knowledge platform: turn raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki.
general.description_zh: 开源 LLM 知识平台：将原始文档转化为可查询的 RAG、自主推理 agent 和自维护 Wiki。

general.description: OpenRouter for agent tools. Join community here: https://discord.gg/6mQYYfFMAn
general.description_zh: 面向 agent 工具的 OpenRouter。加入社区：https://discord.gg/6mQYYfFMAn

general.name: mksglu/context-mode
general.description: Context window optimization for AI coding agents. Sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks.
general.description_zh: 面向 AI 编码 agent 的上下文窗口优化。沙箱化工具输出（减少 98%），持久化会话记忆，并通过 MCP + hooks 在 17 个平台间强制路由。

general.description: The open-source app everyone uses to manage agents at work
general.description_zh: 人人都在用的开源工作智能体管理应用

general.name: DietrichGebert/ponytail
general.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
general.description_zh: 让你的 AI agent 像房间里最懒的资深开发者一样思考。最好的代码就是你从未写过的代码。

general.name: anthropics/claude-code
general.description: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase, and helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, explaining complex code, and handling git workflows - all through natural language commands.
general.description_zh: Claude Code 是一款驻留在终端中的智能编码工具，能够理解你的代码库，通过自然语言命令执行日常任务、解释复杂代码、处理 git 工作流，帮助你更快地编写代码。

general.description: 🧠 Train a 64M-parameter LLM from scratch in just 2h!

general.description_zh: Cursor 插件规范及官方插件

general.name: trycua/cua
general.description: Scale computer-use 2.0 with open-source drivers, cross-OS fleets, and benchmarks for training, evaluation, and data generation.
general.description_zh: 通过开源驱动、跨操作系统集群以及用于训练、评估和数据生成的基准测试，扩展 computer-use 2.0。

general.name: TencentCloud/Octop
general.description: A smarter, self-hosted AI assistant — multi-user, multi-agent.
general.description_zh: 更智能的自托管 AI 助手——支持多用户、多智能体。

general.name: NVIDIA/SkillSpector
general.description: Security scanner for AI agent skills. Detect vulnerabilities, malicious patterns, security risks, prompt injection, data exfiltration, and supply-chain risks in Claude Code, Codex, and MCP skills before you install them.
general.description_zh: 面向 AI agent 技能的安全扫描器。在安装前检测 Claude Code、Codex 和 MCP 技能中的漏洞、恶意模式、安全风险、prompt injection、数据外泄及供应链风险。
